title: Settlement, City, District & Street Cartography
objective: Implement urban cartographic authoring for districts, blocks, lots, streets and alleys, walls and gates, waterways, building footprints, landmarks and service markers, density patterns and reusable urban map styles while allowing Settlement/MBES data to seed or bind maps without duplicating or mutating canonical settlement or built-environment truth.

scope.purpose: Provide settlement/city/district/street cartography over completed MCS authoring foundations while preserving Settlement, World and built-environment owner truth outside the drawing system.
scope.completion_gate: Representative settlement and city maps can deterministically author and inspect districts, blocks, lots, streets/alleys, walls/gates, waterways, building footprints, landmarks/service markers, density patterns and reusable urban styles while Settlement/MBES data may seed or bind projections without being duplicated or mutated by drawing.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 and MCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json schema 0.3.0 were reconsulted after MCS-10 exact-tree publication. No cross-program rotation detour supersedes the surviving MCS strict order, so MCS-13 is selected.
MCS-13 consumes the completed MCS authoring and procedural-proposal foundations and owns settlement/city cartographic projections only.
Settlement, World and reduced MBES retain canonical settlement, population and built-environment truth; their data may seed or bind MCS maps without being duplicated or mutated by drawing.

Districts, blocks, lots, streets/alleys, walls/gates, waterways, building footprints, landmarks/service markers, density patterns and reusable urban styles remain cartographic authoring/projection state unless an owning domain explicitly binds or accepts them.
MCS-13 is selected_not_started only; no implementation branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue.
MCS-14, PCA-16, MCCS, MRCS, MSAS, MNCS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized by this selection.
next_action: Wait for the next owner Continue. On that command, governed-start MCS-13 with the OPS3 execution guard; do not implement while selected_not_started.

stop_reason.evidence: MCS-13 is selected_not_started after fresh post-MCS-10 DAG/backlog reconciliation; no bounded MCS-13 execution is active.
